text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the earnest vegetable farming—
lately, the students gathering in the cafeteria
have been smiling even more brightly than ever.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmggghhh!!
Every single one looks so deliciousssss!!
Thank you for the foooood!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez, so loud!
I get that it's delicious, so just eat quietly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. Everyone's making such buono faces
while eating the food, aren't they!
I'm so glad♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: As the one who made it, that truly makes me so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That really is...
something to be happy about... isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, are you alright?!
You don't look happy about this at all?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...The truth is, I'm not okay. Right now, the academy is... a gentle hell!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because... but...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of them...
is just so delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...If I gain weight, I can't run.
The races are what matter most...
I know that, but..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But...! I still want to eat!
I want to eat it all! My stomach cannot tell a lie~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the cafeteria...
At this point, it's both heaven and hell to me..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
…………
Seriously, you... And here I thought you had a real problem.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But Rice knows how you feel!
Managing your nutrition and weight is really hard...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm!
Indeed, it is certainly not something to be taken lightly!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Self-restraint is second nature to athletes such as yourselves.
Hence, countless students suffer from gnawing hunger!
Take a look over there, for instance—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
…………
*sluuuurp*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Strawberry, dear Strawberry...
Who is it that you wish to be eaten by most...?
...It is nothing. Please pay me no mind."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*! Well, there might be some
overly extreme examples, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, if one exercises excessive, thoughtless restraint,
they could ruin their health and cause their performance
to plummet in an instant. Truly a formidable challenge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Not being able to eat buono food
with all your might must be so painful.
............

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, something filling, low in calories...
and well-balanced nutritionally—
T-This is hard...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da~n! Great job, Flower-chan!
Let me join in too, let me in~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And the veggie squad has arrived too!
We can make lo~ts of prototypes now~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Akebono-san!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~. Holding back might be important sometimes, but
after all, I want to clash with everyone
using all of my strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When it's mealtime, you've gotta feel bono from the bottom of your heart!
Don't you think so too, Flower-chan?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Healthy, yet completely satisfying...
If only I could cook meals like that...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! In whatever small way I can,
I shall lend you my strength as well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Even the Chairwoman?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, this is all for the students!
I shall gladly assist with peeling or whatever else is needed!
Furthermore...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I can also serve as a taste tester...! In order
to connect with the students' feelings, I worked as
hard as possible to work up a big appetite...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
C-Chairwoman...! ...Alright.
Anyway, I'll just get my hands moving first!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! This ultra-firm mapo tofu is delicious!
By intentionally cooking low-calorie tofu to be firmer, it increases the chewing count and amplifies satiety! Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Amazing, right?
I made sure to drain the water from the tofu really well~☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! If I can knead vegetables into ramen noodles,
or make the pot-au-feu ingredients
with just the perfect, satisfying crunch!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...All right! Well then, it's about time to refine the prototype
and develop a full-fledged recipe—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
F-F-Food...
Smells so... so good...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
…………
W-What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The smell... of ingredients... Carrots, potatoes, garlic, chili peppers, strawberries... So many wonderful scents...

text_block_list.name: Spe & Oguri
text_block_list.text:
WANT... TO EAT...
OPEN... THIS...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh~ This is bad!?
Both Spe-chan and Oguri-san are
so hungry they've gone on a rampage-buono~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh no...! The recipe is almost finished, but
if our ingredients get eaten now...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mumu...! Leave this to me!
I'll take one of the prototypes and run,
distracting the students until they're complete!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What?! That sounds dangerous~?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the students! True education requires putting oneself on the line!
Take this!"

text_block_list.name: Spe & Oguri
text_block_list.text:
Feeeed meeee!
Give me food~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Waaah~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Chairwoman...! Please, stay safe...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Let's trust the Chairwoman for now~! We need to
finish the menu as quickly as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Helllooo, aaanyoneee theeeere~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, regretful!
Is this as far as I go!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec~!
The recipe is finished~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! Oguri-san, Spe-san,
please enjoy these dishes!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Spe & Oguri
text_block_list.text: ...So yummy~!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, for a moment there I wondered what would happen,
but I'm thrilled we managed to make the announcement without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much!
For every single thing...! If it weren't for you, Chairwoman, I definitely couldn't have finished it.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "No, no! I am the one who should be thanking you!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Behold!
The faces of the students eating your cooking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Eh!? Eating this much,
and it's not even 200 calories!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: C-Can Rice have seconds...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Eat up, eat up~! The Chairwoman worked so hard to make this dish for everyone's sake!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaah...! Thank you for the meal...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to lick the plate clean, but... thanks for the feast...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Self-discipline as an athlete is vital!
However... a life lived with an unfulfilled heart
can hardly be called healthy.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So you've created a dish that overcomes that very contradiction!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is full too!
Seeing the students' smiles made it all worth it!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*! Well then, farewell!
I must get back to my duties!
